otif_definition.rule: OTIF = 1 when actual_delivery_date <= promised_delivery_date + delivery_tolerance_days AND received_quantity >= ordered_quantity * (1 - quantity_tolerance_pct)

scoring.disclaimer: Analytical supplier scorecard and risk model for a synthetic dataset.

five_why.statement: Bramble Adhesives sits in performance tier C with OTIF 82.8%, defect rate 7.04%, and SLA breach rate 6.5%.
OTIF is failing from a mix of lateness and short fills, so a single-cause story would be incomplete. Quality is a second independent failure mode (defect rate 7.04%).
Both cycle-time control and quantity confirmation are drifting at the same time.
The supplier's planning signal from the plant is either late, unstable, or not frozen.
S&OP / IBP handoff into procurement is not translating into a reliable supplier schedule.
There is no joint recovery plan with dated actions, owners, and a re-promise calendar.

Man: Promise dates entered without a capacity check
Quality hold release waiting on a single inspector
Customer-service backlog on ASN / POD confirmation
Machine: Bottleneck work center running above demonstrated capacity
Test equipment downtime extending quality release
Pack line changeovers during peak mix weeks
Method: No ATP gate before PO acknowledgement
SLA measured on ship date rather than dock date
Partial receipts closed without a remainder PO
Material: Incoming sub-component shortages at the supplier
Lot-to-lot variation on a high-defect material family
Measurement: Promise date and requested date used interchangeably in reports
OTIF calculated at shipment header instead of PO line
Defects recorded after receipt, so in-transit damage is mixed in
Environment: Peak-season carrier capacity in the supplier region
Weather / port congestion overlay on long-lead lanes
Plant receiving-dock calendar not shared with the supplier

corrective_actions.action: Re-promise remaining open POs using demonstrated P90 lead time
Stand up a weekly OTIF huddle with late-line aged list
Qualify an alternate source for the top defective material family
Freeze a 4-week forecast fence and share it via the procurement schedule
